notes.title: A Truly Terrifying World of Tanks Blitz Update
notes.notes: [p]October is set to unleash all sorts of horrors into the night. Nameless terrors that lurk in the depths of the fog, with only mysterious sounds to be heard emanating from the darkness. Sound scary? Well, the scariest is yet to come![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="W_rDJumqxGM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Infected Front Mode[/h2][p][/p][p]A new mode sees two powers clash: 10 brave Survivalists against 4 Undead warriors.[/p][list][*][p]The Survivalists' goal is to capture a base at any cost. They must be exceptionally cautious—fallen fighters will respawn and join the ranks of the infected as enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]The goal of the Undead is to wipe out the living. They lack thick armor, but their beefed-up speed more than makes up for this. Not to mention their immortality... Think you took one down? No... Infected tanks respawn almost immediately and return to the fight.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fear is not a word that's in the Survivalists' lexicon. Tenacity in the face of overwhelming odds only releases their hidden power. The fewer they are, the stronger they become: HP and damage increase, reload time decreases.[/p][p] [/p][p]Will the Survivalists stand firm? Or will the Undead infect them all? Rush into battle on October 9 to find out![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b17edc5d1d9c087f7474ddf2d8342ebba13b6585.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Damage Indicator[/h2][p][/p][p]Enjoy full control over every battle! The battle interface has been updated with a dynamic damage indicator showing three key values in real time: Damage Dealt, Assisted Damage, and Damage Blocked.[/p][p] [/p][p]You can switch it on or off in the Settings anytime.[/p][p][/p][h2]Horrorstadt Will Make You Shudder! [/h2][p][/p][p]An evil night descends on Alpenstadt. Evil forces lurk in the darkness... Don't let their silent presence scare you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0855716a073871a9b5332b496cdb9b517245f79b.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]The Terrifying Garage[/h2][p][/p][p]In late October, the Garage will transform and take on sinister colors. Occasionally, the walls glow with terrifying hues as mystical symbols appear. Overhead, the cold moon watches you from the dark skies. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ab6a388dcaaf635ad74e38860abc3403225096af.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: World of Tanks Blitz is getting a fresh update!
notes.notes: [h2]Polish TDs[/h2][p][/p][p]Strong frontal armor, high firepower, and decent mobility—check out the all-new branch of Polish tank destroyers! Here's the line up: SDP 40 Zadymka, SDP 44 Burza, SDP 57 Gowika, SDP 58 Kilana, SDP 60 Gonkiewicza, and dangerous as lightning—NC 70 Błyskawica! They all handle themselves confidently on the frontline and don't shy away from prolonged firefights.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="s4tEIM2dE4Q;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Starting from Tier VIII, these vehicles may surprise you with new firing mechanics: the closer you get to the enemy, the more damage you'll deal! The full potential of these TDs becomes apparent at close range, so don't linger in the bushes—rush into the epicenter of battle with your allies![/p][p][/p][h2]Swedish Voiceover[/h2][p][/p][p]The crews of Swedish vehicles will speak their native language! To hear it, enable the "National Crew Voice" option (Settings → Other) and head into battle in Swedish tanks. Let's roll! Or rather— "utgå!"[/p][p][/p][h2]Ready for Some Action?[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Path of Legends: August 28 – September 24[/b][/p][p]Watch a special video about our WoT Blitz adventures, pick up a gift, and complete a quest![/p][p] [/p][p][b]"One of Three" Event: August 28 – September 30[/b][/p][p]Collect Pins via different activities to swap for one of three tanks of your choice: FV201 (A45), Škoda T 27, or Kpz. Pr.68 (P).[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Boosters for Victories: August 28 – September 5[/b][/p][p]Play European tanks and receive a Cooldown booster for every victory![/p][p] [/p][p][b]"Objective: Sheridan Missile" Event: September 12–21[/b][/p][p] Show an unearthly level of skill, earn Missiles for your victories and take the legendary Sheridan Missile — a special Collector tank with missiles![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Blacksmith Forge Event: September 19–28[/b][/p][p]Collect Iron Mugs to exchange for resources, containers, and powerful tanks like the unique LKpz.70 K![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Blitz Diamond Cup Final[/b][/p][p]Watch September's official streams covering the most important battles of the tournament and get rewards for being a viewer! All dates and details will be shared in upcoming news articles.[/p]

notes.title: World of Tanks Blitz Birthday Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Birthday Activities[/h1]
Blitz hits another milestone this June, and the party is bigger than ever: unique activities and a heap of gifts await! Thanks for all of your ideas in the comments—some of the best made it into this update!

[previewyoutube=1akw6RD_FsM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Seniority Award[/h3]
Log in from June 5 through July 6 to claim your festive container. The older your account, the bigger the loot inside!

[h3]Tanks From the Tutorial[/h3]
The Type 58, Tiger I, T-34-85, and Sherman Easy 8 are the very first tanks every new player meets in Blitz. We’ve given them a fresh touch and hidden them across various activities. Play this summer to grab them for free! The first one will be available via subscription from June 16 through 23. Don't miss it!

[h3]Blitz Fest Event[/h3]
Get ready for something totally fresh! You’ll have several paths to choose from, each packed with rewards. From June 20 through July 4, explore the paths and earn rewards—including the brand-new Tiger-Maus! Complete any path to get the Bisonte C45 for free!

[h3]Tank as a Gift[/h3]
Log in from June 26 through July 13 to get your hands on the Turbo Collector tank with the Firestorm Legendary camo. Festive customization included!

[h1]Maps[/h1]
You asked—we delivered! For Blitz’s birthday, we’re bringing back some beloved maps:  Lost Temple, Mirage, and Malinovka! Old favorites return, unchanged and unforgettable—just the way we loved them back then ❤️‍🔥

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1c986b45fb2f63422f02b1ad9222649925744ef4.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Minimap Design[/h1]
In battle, quick situational awareness is key—even experienced tankers rely on the Minimap. We’ve updated its design to make it more realistic and easier to read in the heat of battle.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
We've rebalanced 12 Tier VIII–IX vehicles based on your feedback. Some got stronger armor; others now reload faster. [url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/vehicle-changes-june-2025/]Find all the details on our website.[/url]

notes.title: Season 5: Legends Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Season 5: Legends[/h2]
Embark on a search for legends alongside outstanding explorers! Three months of unforgettable adventures await with cool rewards for the taking—Power Cells are among them! Use them to restore unique tanks and touch true legends!

[previewyoutube=Mdp5tdAKzRk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]French Medium Tanks[/h2] 
Four agile French vehicles are available to research! High speed and a two-shell magazine are among the strengths of this branch. A perfect combo for scouts!

And the powerful Projet Murat is on top. It takes this Tier X tank less than 3 seconds to deal 740 damage! Avoid enemy return fire by maneuvering and changing position in a flash. Once the magazine has reloaded—attack!

[h2]10 vs. 10 Mode[/h2]
Looking to ramp up the action? Head this way! The rules are simple: clear the map of 10 enemy tanks to lead your team to victory. Develop new battle strategies and deal even more damage to have ultimate fun!

[h2]Crew Mastery[/h2]
An experienced crew is the key to success in battle! That's why all tanks are going to come with 100% trained crew right after purchase! You won't have to spend credits and gold on crew training, and upgrading skills has become easier as well.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2] 
This update ushers in new ways of playing for Tier X tanks. The main purpose of this round of rebalancing is to brush up the gameplay of familiar vehicles and beef up the advantages of less popular war machines.

[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/update-season-5/]More Details[/url][/b][/quote]

notes.title: Season 4: Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Season 4: Anniversary[/h2]

This time, it's more than just a seasonal event with a beautiful story. For three months, we'll be broadcasting a whole spectrum of fun to you! So prepare for the most vibrant and intense summer in the game's history! And remember: if there's a screen, there's Blitz 😉

[previewyoutube=MPA5DJhsGKI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]"What If?..." Tank Progression[/h2]

You'll find a chain of stages with rewards on the Season's main screen. These are three unique Tier VII, VIII, and IX tanks with a myriad of upgrades. Each tank will be assembled in the Garage based on the resources you receive during the campaign.

The E-10, DTH-STR, and KV-JR... Vehicles that look oh-so-familiar, and that's no accident! We've selected players' favorite tanks and imagined how they could perform at another tier.

[h2]Italian Heavy Tanks[/h2]

The Italian vehicle branch just got a boost with four new heavies. These swift sharpshooters are perfect for second-line combat. The Tier VII Carro d'assalto P.88 shines with its standard gun and quick reload. Meanwhile, the Tier VIII Progetto CC55 mod. 54 and Tier IX Progetto C50 mod. 66 feature a two-shell magazine that lets them deal hefty damage in mere seconds.

At the top of the branch is the powerful Rinoceronte equipped with a two-shell gun. Mobile and accurate, with a comfortable gun and armored turret, this heavy can take down enemies in a flash! But be warned: When using your turret armor, keep moving to make it even harder for enemies to hit your vulnerable spots.

[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/update-22-05/]More Details[/url][/b][/quote]

notes.title: Season 3: Resistance update
notes.notes:
[h2]Season 3: Resistance[/h2]
The main event will take place somewhere in the alpine meadows, and unfold with an epic battle scene. The best commanders of different nations will unite to stop an unknown enemy and determine the fate of humanity.

Resistance will last three months. There are many battles and challenges ahead, during which you'll collect enough Snippets to build three unique tanks!

[previewyoutube=i-jAwn_UgRU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Chinese heavy tanks[/h2]
Four new heavy tanks in the Chinese Tech Tree! Tier VII and VIII tanks are well-armored and strike hard. The Tier IX BZ-68 is just like them, and also boasts impressive speed for a heavy tank. The Tier X BZ-75 has all the advantages of these three, but with an even better armored hull. Besides that, higher-tier tanks are equipped with alternative guns with high single-shot damage and average accuracy.

[h2]New sounds[/h2]
Improved hit sound in both Arcade and Sniper Modes. Ricochet will also get its own sound.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
This time, Tier IX tanks will have balance improvements. They're dedicated to freshening up your gaming experience with 22 vehicles. Some of them received an armor upgrade.

[h2]Camouflage Rotation[/h2]
The Spooky for the Kpz RH, Baba-Yaga for the IS-7, Terrifying for the Chimera, and Wavebreaker for the XM551 Sheridan are now available in the camo selection menu.

[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/update-season-3/]MORE DETAILS[/url][/b][/quote]

notes.title: Season 2: Constellation Update
notes.notes:
Join the adventurers and lead them through the Season—a dangerous and exciting 3-month-long challenge that will bring you rewards. Together you will solve the mystery of the Swamp Monster and collect enough Fortium Shards to build three unique vehicles!

[previewyoutube=_MA90PvURrw;full][/previewyoutube]

It is a large-scale update of the game that includes new vehicles, balance changes, and fresh content. All in-game elements are designed to immerse you in a new story, from the Garage to the camos, the Orders, and the bundles in the Store.

[h2]Polish Medium Tanks[/h2]

Please welcome the newbies in the Tech Tree of the European Nation: six medium tanks flying the Polish colors! Their advantages are speed, dynamics, and great firepower!

[h2]Updated Platoon Interface[/h2]

Now your Garage looks different once you have created a platoon or accepted an invitation to join one. The camera will travel outside to show two tanks: yours and your platoon mate's. The looks of your mate's tank are updated in real-time and show the applied modules, attachment, and camo.

[h2]Updated Quick Commands[/h2]

We are working hard to improve the quick commands wheel to make it more useful and easier to understand in order to enhance coordination in battle. New commands are displayed in your battle chat, in the minimap, and on the battle screen.

The Hold position! command has been replaced with Moving here! Hover the camera's marker over a point on the landscape, or an allied or enemy tank, and press this command to let your allies see the marker on the minimap and the main battle screen. Yes! They will see exactly the hill or building the camera was pointed at!

[h2]Maps[/h2]

This Season's rotation will not include:
• Mayan Ruins
• Winter Malinovka
• Black Goldville
• Fort Despair
• Dead Rail

And these are making their comeback!
• Vineyards
• Dynasty's Pearl
• Copperfield
• Port Bay
• Ghost Factory

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

We've changed a lot! We've updated the characteristics of 88 vehicles, which include 61 Tier X tanks. The goal is not only to increase the effectiveness of the tanks which can't boast great stats, but also to revamp the gameplay of the usual vehicles. Some tanks will noticeably strengthen their principal characteristics, while others will change their role in gameplay. 

[h3][url=https://eu.wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/update-season-2/]MORE[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Update 9.8
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Se4Ql-gZ1oU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]The Quick Commands Wheel[/h2]
Quick and smooth teamwork is what it takes to KEEP CALM AND WIN epic victories. It's high time to improve our quick commands. The first step is to update the way they look and how they are sent. Icons have become clearer while the commands are now grouped more logically. These updates have resulted in faster team coordination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/30273907a03bb89ca450f9016b432dd187999304.jpg[/img]
[h3]On touch devices[/h3]
[list]
[*] Place the quick commands wheel button on the screen where it's best for you.
[*] Tap once on the quick commands wheel button to send the "Attack!" command.
[*] Aim at a specific tank and tap once on the quick commands wheel button to let your allies know that you are going to attack this target.
[*] Tap and hold the quick commands wheel button, then select an icon you need to send out any other command.
[/list][h3]On PC[/h3]
[list]
[*] Click the quick commands wheel button and move your mouse as needed to send out quick commands. Forget about hot keys. 😉
[*] You can also send quick commands the old-fashioned way using Ctrl.
[/list]
You will learn the new controls in no time, and all your movements will become instinctive. And this is just the beginning as we are planning to roll out new commands to bring team coordination in battle to a whole new level!

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[h3]Bisonte C45[/h3]
[list]
[*] The lower glacis plate armor was increased from 25 to 55 mm.
[/list][h3]T34 and T34 (1776)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Engine power was increased from 810 to 880 hp.
[*] The turret's front armor was enhanced from 178 to 187 mm.
[/list][h2]Legendary Camouflage[/h2]
The camo selection menu has been updated with Konung for the Strv K, Sandsturm for the Tiger (P), D-Gunner for the T28 Defender, Chronos for the Object 268 Version 4 and Eagle for the E 75 TS.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/b1d865abaf18710ebcb8744e670f0b292414bf84.jpg[/img]

New Legendary camos will be offered to the owners of these tanks: 
[list]
[*] the hi-tech Futuro for WZ-132-1
[*] the daring Runner for Bat.-Châtillon 25 t
[*] the armor-plated Turtle for T95
[*] the extremely hazardous H-Combat for T34
[*] the racing Breakneck for Ru 251
[*] the woodland Tarnkappe for Rhm.-Borsig Waffenträger
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4a87fbc8996b2b55d352500fa936b21d6f018380.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The following tanks, along with their Legendary camos, have been updated to a new graphics quality: E 75 and Garm, Progetto M40 mod. 65 and Gladiator, and Vickers Mk. E Type B.
[*] You can now listen to music right in the Garage. Adjust the volume in Settings/ Other/ Music Volume.
[*] A player's position on the rating battles leaderboard has been added to their profile and the rating stats screens.
[*] Vehicle research progress has been added to the second battle results screen.
[*] Replay recording is now enabled by default.
[*] Areas where vehicles became stuck were fixed, and the models of buildings and objects were adjusted for some maps.
[*] Ambient sounds in battle have been improved for mobile devices.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications have also been improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes have been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9.7
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=0zoyq8kv7PQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Chinese Light Tanks Branch[/h2]
Meet five daring light tanks — swift, compact, featuring great damage per minute and a short aiming time! Tier IX and X vehicles come with a new Adaptive Concealment mechanic.
[h2]Sunlit Middleburg[/h2]
The map has been visually revamped! More realistic lighting and materials will make your gaming experience even more immersive. The updated Middleburg map features more light and objects, while its gameplay didn't change. Well, only that it's now covered by more trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6fbcd459f64389fb12b25cc194a40aa45be15fbf.jpg[/img]

If your device isn't ready for the new Middleburg graphics, you can enable the medium quality option for objects and terrain in the settings. At the same time, the graphics of maps that haven't yet been updated to the new visual quality will remain the same.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
This time, changes affected four branches of different nations: Japanese heavies, French tank destroyers, and German and American medium tanks. Playing these well-known vehicles will now bring you lots of new experiences and emotions. Rebalancing will emphasize the playstyle succession inside branches, fully unfolding it at the highest tier.
[h2]Camouflage[/h2]
New Legendary camos will await owners of two predators: the snowy Irbis for the Leopard 1 and the flaming Colossus for the Löwe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/50b70cfa53eb74f1c629dd30775c06a6acdf2822.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/58256675e6b2d0e8c5c589bd5f02bc5ac3bf64d9.jpg[/img] 

More than a dozen Legendary and Rare camos, including Moderno for the Controcarro 3 Minotauro, Ammoel for the T57 Heavy Tank, and Hugo for the Caliban, became available in the camo selection menu.

The Grandma's Gift, Starlight Night, and Evergreen camos will no longer be available for purchase.
[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2][list]
[*] Added Ukrainian localization of the game.
[*] The following tanks, along with their Legendary camos, were updated to the new graphics quality: the Rhm.-Borsig Waffenträger, the FV4005 and Overkill, the IS-4 and Skilled.
[*] Rewards in daily containers and containers for completing missions were changed. Parts of the certificate for Premium Account will be replaced with a mission for receiving a mastery badge. Complete this mission to get certificates for x3–x5 XP as a reward.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9.6
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Xf6M92k0Mao;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Clear Sound for Small Speakers [/h2]
In this Update, shot sounds have been improved so that they can be heard clearly, without being distorted or muffled, not only on high-end audio systems but also on ordinary smartphones, tablets, and small speakers. 
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
IS
[list]
[*] 100 mm D10T stock gun: Aiming time of the stock/top turret was decreased from 6.6/6.5 to 6.3/6 s.
[*] 122 mm D2-5T stock gun: Gun aiming time was reduced from 6.9 to 6.6 s.
[*] 122 mm D-25T top gun: Gun aiming time was reduced from 6.8 to 6.2 s. Gun reload time was decreased from 14.38 to 13.9 s.
[*] Vehicle traverse speed on the spot was decreased from 36.49/40.4 to 30.45/34.11 deg/s for the stock/top chassis, respectively.
[*] View range of stock/top turrets was decreased from 230/240 to 225/230 m.
[/list]
[h2]Legendary Camouflages[/h2]
New Legendary camos will await owners of several tanks. The first two on the list are the Förster for the Grille 15, which looks like it came straight out of the deepest of woods, and the Steppe for the IS, that's sure to appeal to lovers of historical camouflages. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7328bd1476cc4d33590e3db314c232da5cf2aba1.jpg[/img]

The primeval Jötunn for the E 100, the striking Poison for the T92E1, the historical Taiga and Tundra for the SU-152, the mythical Garm for the E 75, and the audacious Basher for the AMX 50 100 were added to the camo selection menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/6ee3aec3a3165185089afae3d000415e2ce6c3df.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The following tanks, along with their Legendary camos, were updated to the new graphics quality: Caernarvon Action X (Resolute and Morpho camos), Leopard 1 (Wild camo), and STB-1 (Adamant camo).
[*] iOS: WoT Blitz is now supported only on devices with Apple A7 SoC and later: iPhone 5s, iPad Air, iPad mini 2, iPod touch 6, and newer. Update 9.6 and subsequent game versions will not be available on older devices with 32-bit processors. The game no longer supports iOS 9 and 10. To continue playing, please make sure your device is running iOS 11 or newer.
[*] macOS: The game no longer supports macOS 10.11 El Capitan and 10.12 Sierra. To continue playing, please upgrade your computer to macOS 10.13 High Sierra or newer.
[*] A new button that allows you to copy any nickname and user ID appeared in the player profile.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 9.4
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=G3T6bkpJI4g;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Branch of Italian TDs[/h2]
Six hardened tank destroyers featuring an impressive amount of HP are now available for research! The new branch is proudly headed by the Controcarro 3 Minotauro, an assault vehicle with a 130-mm gun. Its impeccable Moderno Legendary camouflage expertly combines state-of-the-art elements with a tribute to a myth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/cee0644d83053215a9167ac80544ae17029fcaab.jpg[/img]

Starting from Tier VII, the new tank destroyers are equipped with an autoreloading system. At the same time, unlike Italian medium tanks, shell reload time is configured in a special way for the new TDs. The first shot of a fully loaded magazine autoreloads faster than the others. If you fire only that first shot, you can cause maximum damage per minute (which will be much higher than specified in the characteristics). It should be noted that autoreloading the first shell into an empty magazine can take more than 20 seconds. So it makes sense to unleash the entire magazine only in case of emergency, when the enemy will be destroyed for sure or when your allies can cover you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ab4c24586d0cfbbc5d3a8c19d85602ed97218a06.jpg[/img]

[h2]Matchmaker[/h2]
Now, there will be two queues for entering a battle. The common one is for medium or high skilled commanders. The second one is for those with low battle efficiency. After training and gaining some combat experience, players from the second group will be able to return to the common queue.

[h2]Legendary Camouflage[/h2]
Owners of the following four tanks will soon receive offers to buy new Legendary camos: the fantastic Ammoel for the T57 Heavy, the gothic Darkwing for the WT auf Pz. IV, the realistic Ghost for the KV-1, and the even more realistic Jäger for the Kampfpanzer 50 t. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0057994101121035a78b753a12b32dcc02d6cd3b.jpg[/img]

The cosmic LunarX for the Rover, the mighty Skvělý for the Škoda T 45, the shining Excalibur for the GSOR 1008, the forest Leshy for the Object 274a, and the dependable Baron for the Tiger I became available in the camo selection menu.

[h2]Restoring Sold Vehicles[/h2]

You can now easily get back a sold Premium or Collector tank without leaving the game! Use the Restore Tank option in the vehicle carousel, on the tank stats screen in the Profile, or in the Store. You'll see a list of vehicles sold within the last 3 months, the date of sale, and the restoration price. You'll be able to restore vehicles sold before this period via Player Support. Please note that vehicles sold prior to Update 9.2 won't be on the list.

[code]The restoration price in gold is equal to the purchase price. The restoration price in credits is 10% higher than the purchase price. [/code]
[h2]Lower Resolution[/h2]

We've reworked the Lower Resolution option to enhance gameplay comfort. Owners of less powerful devices will appreciate the change in the Static Lower Resolution: It now reduces the resolution of only landscape objects and tanks, while all elements of the battle interface remain clear.

Dynamic Lower Resolution will now ensure that the image is less blurry, improving your gaming experience. The tracking of high loads and FPS drops on iOS devices was improved: The option won't be activated unless necessary. In addition, Dynamic Lower Resolution is now available for PCs. Mac owners with high-resolution Retina displays will especially appreciate this since the option will be enabled by default.

[h2]Legendary Camos[/h2]

[h2]Japanese Heavies[/h2]
The Japanese Tech Tree has grown a new branch of six researchable heavy tanks. All of them boast strong armor and good mobility. Starting from Tier VII, tanks of the new branch feature unique equipment that improves either ground crossing capacity or vertical gun turn limits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/3f56cc6ebda54479c4b28ce422bef8e87d2842c8.jpg[/img]

[h2]Even More Realism[/h2]
The Garage and Castilla map have received new graphics that will delight you with realistic materials and lighting. Trees sway from blast waves caused by shots and explosions, branches move apart as tanks drive through bushes… In three words, it's sheer beauty! The new dynamic resolution option will help you appreciate it to the fullest. Make sure to check out the system requirements and enjoy improvements without any drops in performance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4be9be2a49dc9750ecc18b0b92f02f1ec84231d0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Reactions and Reports[/h2]
We've been planning to rework the military honor functionality for a long time and finally decided to split it into Reactions and Reports. Reactions allow one to express their emotions after battle. They're like emojis or stickers in a messaging app. Reports are a whole different story. They're intended for reporting violations, such as unsporting conduct, provocative communication, or inactivity in battle. The new system will identify and impose just punishment on regular offenders based on your reports, so don't let them get away with misbehavior.

[previewyoutube=difdJhhuCZc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Maximum Damage in the Profile[/h2]
In the player profile, military honor will be replaced with information about maximum damage, such as the amount of damage, in which vehicle, and on which map the damage was dealt, as well as the date and time. 
[quote] These stats don't include battles fought prior to Update 9.0 or battles in fun modes. [/quote]
[h2]New Aiming Mechanic[/h2]
Following many open tests, research studies, and player surveys, we've reworked the aiming system. The reticle's appearance will remain the same while its behavior will significantly change. The reticle indicator will react better to the player's actions, move smoother relative to the terrain, and follow the target more accurately.

[previewyoutube=oW1kV_2PqFU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New Operation Mechanics[/h2]
It's now easier to complete Operations! You can complete missions within a week without losing progress for any days you may have missed. The number of levels has been adjusted too, decreasing from 80 to 60. However, the number of rewards remains mostly unchanged. Finally, a License that allows for Operations to be completed in a more straightforward manner has also been introduced.

[h2]Premium Shells Economy[/h2]
We're continuing to refine the way the game's economy works. This time, we're making some adjustments that affect Premium shells. Their cost is now directly related to the tank's tier, as well as to their penetration and damage. Some shells purchased using gold and credits will go up in price slightly, while some will become cheaper. The cost of shells for Premium tanks will become less or remain the same.

[h2]Battle Results Improvement[/h2]
After analyzing the feedback collected from players regarding the updated battle results screens, we decided to return Base XP. It will be displayed in all battle types except Rating Battles. By default, players' results are sorted by damage caused, but we also added the option to sort them by XP. Due to interface specifics, long nicknames may be displayed in a shortened form in battle results.

[h2]Legendary Camos[/h2]
The mythical Qinglong for the Type 59, the daring Interceptor for the T-100 LT, the wild Rhino for the M48A2 Räumpanzer, the mighty Vigilant for the Object 252U, and the venomous Snakebite for the Krupp-Steyr Waffenträger became available in the camo selection menu.

Owners of the following three tanks will soon receive offers to buy new Legendary camos: the cartoonish Win Peaks for the AMX 30 1er prototype, the jade Gongbi for the WZ-120-1G FT, and the post-apocalyptic Burn for the K-91.

[list]
[*] The Vickers Mk. F, the Jagdpanzer E 100 with its Mighty Legendary camo and Spezialset attachment, as well as the Grille 15 with its Troublemaker and RA1DER Legendary camos received improved graphics.

[*] The bug where it was difficult to get a drowned enemy tank out of the crosshairs was fixed.

Users of iOS and Android mobile devices will be able to reset the timer of the XP multiplier for the first victory (x2 timer). The refresh timer and the watching ads button will appear near the Battle! button. Watch an ad and the x2 XP multiplier will refresh. It's a great way to research your dream tank faster!

The price of training for Regimental School (up to 75%) or Tank Academy (up to 100%) used to be fixed and didn't depend on your level of mastery. Now it decreases as your crew mastery grows. It's time to make changes to the way the matchmaker selects vehicles for battles. Light and medium tanks used to have different values in the matchmaker. So there were rarely cases when teams were unequal. As the way to play medium and light tanks is more similar, the matchmaker will consider them to be the same type. This means it will strive to make the ratio of light and medium tanks, as well as other vehicles, the same for both teams.

Now it's easier to monitor your tank's key parameter! The indicator became bigger, its color changes from green to red, and the amount of HP lost is displayed with a visual effect. When penetrated, the indicator blinks.

notes.title: Update 8.4
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=2zVHyDdPwEE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Polish Heavies[/h2]
The new branch of five researchable Tier VI–X heavy tanks has joined the European Nation! Each is well-armed, perfectly armored, and very dangerous! These Poles come with their own consumables that will bring you new tactical opportunities. Both newcomers and experienced commanders will enjoy riding the new heavies into battle.

[quote][b][url=https://wotblitz.com/news/event/new-polish-tanks/]Details![/url][/b][/quote]
[h2]Economy Lesson[/h2]

We're continuing to refine the credit economy. This time, the changes will affect researchable Tier I–VI vehicles. Previously, the number of battles required to accumulate credits and research each subsequent tank could vary quite widely depending on the branch. To balance out this uneven profitability, starting from Update 8.4, some tanks will earn a little more, while others will earn a little less. These changes won't apply to Premium vehicles.

[h2]Holiday Camos and New Arrivals[/h2]

Halloween is coming! While we "probably" won't go from Garage to Garage asking for consumables, it would be nice to dress up for this fun-filled occasion. Spooky Web, Pumpkin Mayhem, Pumpkin Spice, Scary Swarm, and Spidertrap are available again in the Camouflage tab.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/662cc9ee96f0c434634d14e4a9909b801b5e7ff0.jpg[/img]

Also, with Update 8.4, you'll be able to get the harsh Bulwark camo for the harsh T110E3 tank destroyer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8349500c74296fd5278c2d9b555f9fcfeccd74dc.jpg[/img]
[quote] The Black Dragon, Demon's Soul, and Urban Spark camos are no longer available for purchase.[/quote]
Here are the new Legendary camos! Owners of the T95E6 will soon receive an offer to purchase the feisty Piranha camo, while commanders of the AMX 30 B will be offered to get the gorgeous Corsica camo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/4172a9339338c8c03ef1d6915b8338bd65ece9f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9e614e094bee01316540692ee83be295ddf68ee3.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The T57 Heavy with its Tireless Legendary camo, the EMIL 1951 with its Viking Legendary camo, and the M2 Light received improved graphics.
[*] It will now be possible to preview camos on the selected vehicles right from your Storage.
[*] Individual offers now have the option of viewing its items. The contents can be opened by clicking/tapping the bundle.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

The Pride Legendary camouflage for the M-VI-Yoh will be available in the Camo section. The stars and stripes on the front armor and the eagle on the turret have witnessed hundreds of glorious battles.

[list]
    [*]Balance Changes WZ-120 : The depression angle of the top gun was increased from 3 to 5 deg.
    [*]With the exception of the Excelsior, СУ-85И, Matilda BP, Pz. V/IV, Matilda IV, T-25, T14, Dicker Max, IS-6, and T23E3, Premium vehicles were removed from the Tech Tree.

notes.title: Update 8.2
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=iLm4MIv1m1g;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]Download the new version starting August 18![/quote]
[h2]Ghost Factory Is Open!
[/h2]Coal mounds, industrial vehicles, lanes among hills, and a huge abandoned factory complex at the center, which can be considered a map inside a map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1232642d4307f2e77618cc9b24cc48675f3ca16a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Fancy a Cuppa?
[/h2]We're continuing to work on in-game sounds, which is why we're happy to present the much-anticipated British national voiceover! In addition, British English was added to the list of game client localizations. Here's how you can check out this stylish crew accent:[list]
[*] Play in British and Australian (included in the U.K. tech tree) vehicles with the "National crew voice" option enabled (Settings → Other)
[*] Play in any vehicles with English (U.K.) selected in the client (the new localization) and the "National crew voice" option disabled
[/list][quote]Since there is so much text to translate, you may still notice American terms here and there in the British localization. But we're working on this.[/quote]
[h2]Balance and Economy 
[/h2]Inactive players will no longer receive XP or credits for battle. Also, we reconfigured the credit economy and counterbalanced homogenization, a hidden armor parameter.

This time, balance changes were made to Tier X vehicles. The adjustments seek to maintain the gameplay comfort of heavy tanks while preventing them from replacing other types of vehicles. They also aim to enhance the benefits of other types of vehicles. Learn more about these changes on the website.

[h2]Updated Interface
[/h2]It's time to give a new design to the in-game Store. Item cards are now larger, bundle contents are more informative, and discounts are easier to notice. The vertical orientation of tabs corresponds to the Garage's screen design. Moreover, daily containers can be opened in one action. 

The Avatars screen was not left untouched either. Now, it's more similar to the Storage screen. All avatars are divided by category into separate tabs: Premium, Accumulative, Special, Other, and Temporary. Similarly to Storage, to remove the red marker on new avatars, you no longer need to select them. Now you simply need to go to the corresponding tab and view the new avatars. 

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs [/h2][list]
[*] The Strv 74, Leo, Emil I, Emil II, Kranvagn (as well as the Nidhögg and Nord Legendary camos), and WZ-120-1G FT were updated to the new graphics quality.
[*] The Pike Legendary camouflage for the Object 260 was added to the Camo menu.
[*] An effect that shows the battle result ("Victory", "Defeat", "Draw") and a corresponding note ("All tanks destroyed", "Base captured", etc.) was introduced.
[*] The line of accumulative avatars for Rating Battles was extended. Now, each league has 6 levels.
[*] Changes were made to the contents of the Basic Day's Supply and Standard Day's Supply containers. Instead of certificates for purchasing a Tier VI Premium tank, certificates for purchasing Premium tanks of other tiers will now drop from these containers more often.
[*] Some parameters were changed for the Improved Engine Power Boost consumable. Now, it increases engine power by 40%, turn rate by 5%, and maximum forward speed by 5 km/h.
[*] The "Tank Auto-Turn" option was added to the touch control settings. It is intended for newcomers who are accustomed to the fact that the camera prioritizes the direction of movement (like in other shooter games, for example). The option is disabled by default.
[*] The bug where the replay of a battle launched incorrectly if the player hadn't logged into the game was fixed. 
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 8.1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=GBKq7QkN4AQ;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]Download the new version starting July 15![/quote]
[h1]Changes in Armor Highlighting[/h1] 
We tried to eliminate situations when red zones are penetrated and grey ones aren't. Now armor highlighting will be more precise for many tanks. For example, the probability of penetration will display better in situations when armor is at an angle to the aiming point, when there are two layers of armor, or if a shell can punch right through armor.
[quote]Remember that armor highlighting is a hint and not an ultimate rule. It simply shows the possibility of penetration. It doesn't guarantee it. The result of a shot is still affected by multiple factors like +/-5% to dispersion, enemy maneuvers, and other factors. [/quote]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/7a1c9d81e4795cb8ce0059c65d45b9b1b7db326a.png[/img]

[h1]Updated Bonus Containers[/h1]
We reworked the content system of bonus containers (daily, weekly, and three-day containers). 

Newcomers will now get more resources like credits, Credit boosters, and Combat XP boosters from these containers to accelerate their game progress. For skilled commanders, there will be Gold and Cooldown boosters. The higher the vehicle tier, the more valuable the content. 

Moreover, drop chances will be clearer for all containers in the game.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ad516754c8c117171796952e53fedafd0c20d358.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Battle Chat Features[/h1]
If one player destroys a tank that was previously damaged more than 51% by another player, both of them will receive a new notification type. It will show not only the name of the fighter who destroyed the tank, but also the name of the player who assisted. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/0c3eca1f5ccc844b5fdce8d627e58796adb898dd.png[/img]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
In the new update, the parameters of many Tier VII vehicles were adjusted. The changes seek to ensure that tanks of this tier and of the same type have comparable performance and can better play their battle role. In addition, the characteristics of Tier VII–X Collector and Premium vehicles were improved. For example, the FV217 Badger tank destroyer is now faster and more accurate. 
[h1]Control Features[/h1]
Partial support of popular gamepad models for Android is back. Also, all supported platforms now feature sensibility and inversion settings. 

The following main control options are set as default: 
•	Android/iOS: "Touch"
•	Windows 10: "Keyboard and Mouse" (displays as permanently disabled for mobile devices) 

When connecting the gamepad, the "Gamepad" control type will be displayed in settings. You'll need to choose it only once. For future instances, it will be enabled automatically.

The "Same Control Mode" will no longer be available for PC. However, it will be preserved for touch devices. This change will essentially decrease the queue time for PC players.
[h1]Camouflage Rotation and Update[/h1]
We're continuing our big Storage spring cleaning! If your Storage is overflowing with camos, there's a solution: Some of them can now be exchanged for Splinters. Splinters can be exchanged for a Camo Container that will always be available in the Store. This Container features different types of camouflage including standard and animated, with free resupply, and for any vehicle tier. The contents will change from time to time.

There are new items in the Camo menu: the Daredevil Legendary camouflage for the Kunze Panzer, the Standard Bearer attachment for the T-22 medium, and the Mighty Legendary camouflage and Spezialset attachment for the Jagdpanzer E 100.

[quote]The Ghost, Unexpectable, and Thunderbolt camos will no longer be available for purchase.[/quote]
[h1]Legendary Camouflage for the T110E3[/h1]
The owners of this menacing tank destroyer will get an individual offer featuring the Bulwark camo. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8349500c74296fd5278c2d9b555f9fcfeccd74dc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs [/h1]
[list]
   [*]The Vickers Light, Vickers CR, and FV301 were updated to the new visual quality.
 [*]Missions for new players were reworked. 
 [*]The Mines map was removed from rotation for Tier VII–X Rating battles.
 [*]Object 252U: Spare parts kits are now identified as spaced armor.
 [*]The bug where the sinking tank timer was displayed incorrectly in replays was fixed.
 [*]Issues with volume when loading the game and playing the sound of moving tracks were fixed.
 [*]Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
 [*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.9
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=IqZRKVmjVgA;full][/previewyoutube]
[quote]Download the new version starting April 27! [/quote]
[h2]A Smooth Entrance into the Game[/h2]
We reworked the tutorial! From now on, newly-minted commanders won't be sent to the proving grounds. Instead, they'll find themselves in 5-on-5 battles on the Mines map. The first battles will be accompanied by hints depending on the situation. For example, "Enable Aiming mode" in case of a miss or "Target gray parts" in case of a non-penetrating hit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/21e45590bca439ddfa7e0b964ef417bc9ddc8f88.jpg[/img]

The first tank that a newcomer will take into battle will be one of these three famous combat vehicles: the Tiger, the T-34-85, or the Sherman. Moreover, the number of bots will gradually decrease.

[h2]Updated Mines[/h2]
It now has its own special atmosphere! We added effects, actions, and indestructible objects outside the playable part of the map and improved terrain textures. Now, there are planes flying in the sky and warships fighting in the sea. Every new player's first three battles will happen on Mines. But the map will remain available for battles of all tiers.

Mirage and Lost Temple are being reworked and will temporarily be unavailable in the game. They will return with improvements to visuals and gameplay. Both maps will be made available for more tiers, while Mirage will receive a version for Supremacy.
[h2]Colorblind Mode[/h2]
Colorblind mode was added to graphics settings for those who see the world just a bit differently. It changes the colors of important elements in battle so that players with color blindness, such as deuteranomaly, protanopia, and deuteranopia, can better distinguish them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ea1ce09eb8a419f097190bbd02253788a9646e19.jpg[/img]

[quote]This option may affect game performance on some mobile devices. 
[/quote]
[h2]Order in Storage[/h2]
It's time for some spring cleaning! All resources are now carefully divided among four tabs: Certificates, Appearance, Boosters, and Other. What's more, we got rid of excessive tapping. To remove the red dot for new items, you need only scroll down the screen. Red dots will also be removed from accumulative avatars, and they will only appear on the latest avatar in the chain.
[h2]News for the Jagdpanzer E 100[/h2]
It finally happened! If the Jagdpanzer E 100 existed in reality, this is what it would look like. After your first battle in this powerful tank destroyer, you may receive a personal offer for the Mighty Legendary camouflage and Spezialset attachment. There are no bells or whistles—just historical insignia and vivid colors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/2b99c654fdb0fcdf4672daae9f367a31237afabb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Controller Support [/h2]
We returned partial support for popular controller models on iOS, Android, and Windows 10. Now, with the help of a controller, you can do more than just shoot, aim, and move. You can also enable/disable auto-aim, use the Lookout Area camera mode, and switch between shell types. Besides that, the sensitivity of both sticks was adjusted and Garage controls were added. 
[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
This time, just a small number of changes was made to vehicle characteristics. The T-34-100 received improved armor under the turret. Previously, it could be easily penetrated by HE shells. Ammunition capacity increased from 65 to 70 shells and 45 to 48 shells for the Crusader and T54Е1, respectively.  [h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list][*]Container infoscreens were reworked. Their content is now more informative. You can even preview vehicles and camos. 
[*] The sounds of switching shells during battle and tanks exploding in Aiming mode were adjusted.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.7
notes.notes:
[h2]Meet the Czechoslovakians![/h2]
Joining the lineup of the European nation is a branch with five researchable Tier VI–X medium tanks! They are all dynamic fighters with powerful weapons. Three tanks feature quick autoloaders, while two boast classic cannons with high penetration and impressive single-shot damage. At Tier X, the fast and maneuverable TVP T 50/51 awaits with a four-shell magazine-based gun capable of dealing 1,240 HP of damage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8a9896d580ded929370bb5403c64aa769fd6378b.jpg[/img]

[h2]For Newbies and Skilled Players[/h2]
Here's an opportunity for all players to enlarge their tank collection! From now on, after completing the tutorial, each new commander will take part in Steel Raid. This event includes a special mission that will help players better understand the game mechanics while rewarding success with the Т6Е1 and other resources. Experienced players can exchange Mastery Badges for Loza's M4-A2 Sherman during the Assemble event.
[h2]Updating Sound![/h2]
We’ve started the process of replacing the game’s sound engine with a better one, which will enable us to gradually perform a complete sound renewal. At first, the new engine will only be available for some devices. Later on, it will be introduced for all platforms. We haven't made any major changes yet. You may notice a slight difference in the tone of sounds in battle and in the Garage, which might seem a little unusual at first. In the future, all the old files will be replaced, the game sounds will become richer, and national voiceovers and much more will be introduced.
[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2][list]
[*] Support for iPad 3 is ending as its technical characteristics can no longer provide a comfortable gaming experience, even at low settings. In the future, this device will stop receiving updates. 
[*] The bug where the provisions panel was displayed instead of the modifications/abilities panel after the battle start countdown in Mad Games and Uprising was fixed.
[*] The bug where the player's position and minimap markers weren't displayed for the platoon mate after the player respawns in Uprising was fixed.
[*] The bug where the name of the tank was displayed in white despite its type on the Rating: Favorite Tanks screen was fixed. Premium tanks are now displayed in gold and Collector tanks in blue. 
[*] The areas where vehicles would become stuck were fixed and some models of buildings and objects were adjusted for some maps. 
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

Download the new version starting February 24!

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

We're continuing to make balance improvements to middle-tier vehicles. Thus, the TOG II* will receive increased maximum speed, engine power, and frontal turret and hull armor. After the update release, the technical characteristics of four tank destroyers will be changed. The penetration of AP and APCR shells will improve for the Nashorn, Jagdpanther, and Jagdpanzer IV. The latter will also take half a second longer to reload. Last but not least, two guns of the AMX 13 90 will receive a reduced magazine reload time and improved firing accuracy.

[*] The game is no longer supported on devices with Android 4.2 and 4.3. To continue playing, please update your device to version 4.4 or higher.
[*] The bug where a blown-off turret caused damage while moving/pushing it was fixed.
[*] The bug where the game expanded to full-screen mode during battle training was fixed.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.5
notes.notes:
The Garage is covered in snow, a magical train is tooting along, the ground crunches beneath your feet, distant planets are approaching... This Update is going to be loaded, magical, and festive! We'll tell you about the events a bit later, so for now, here's a look at the main changes, balance tweaks, and fixes.

[h2]ATGMs for Fun Modes[/h2]Missiles will be removed for the guns of the T92E1 and XM551 Sheridan. Instead of ATGMs, they'll be able to use HEAT shells with the same penetration and damage. However, fans of missiles will still have an opportunity to fire them as such players will receive the ATGM-equipped Sheridan Missile Collector tank as a gift. This tank can play in Uprising, Gravity Force, Burning Games, and other fun modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c219c4a6e35548d33b6bab5af9f077b0b41d3a72.jpg[/img]

[h2]Holiday Camos[/h2]
Ideal for a cold winter, warm camos like the cozy Grandma's Gift, dreamy Starlight Night, and scented Evergreen are making their return to the camo selection menu. Dress up and have fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/216f6e3509834e0f02ab5937a21b55494a066504.jpg[/img]

[i]The Sinister Traces, Galaxy, Vertigo, Shattered Flames, and Flux camos will no longer be available for purchase.[/i]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
Many Tier VI tanks became more effective: the T-2020 is stronger, the Bat.-Chatillon 25 t reloads shells in its magazine faster, and the KpfPz 70 penetrates more frequently and inflicts more damage. Some changes affected high-tier Swedish and British tanks.

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs
[/h2][list]
[*] For portable and mobile devices, joystick inversion to move backwards was added. This option is disabled by default and available via the Controls tab in Settings.
[*] Nintendo: the bug with incorrect reading of controls type when running the game with a disabled joy-con was fixed.
[*] Nintendo: the bug with incorrect link navigation on info screens was fixed.
[*] iOS: the bug when an email address wasn't linked to the game account when using the "Sign in with Apple" function was fixed.
[*] The bug when sound didn't work upon switching camouflage season slots was fixed.
[*] The bug when Pyroleum Boosters were still displayed in the booster panel was fixed.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 7.4
notes.notes:
[i]Download the new version starting November 11![/i]

[previewyoutube=IkvghJcKDPE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Shot Result Status[/h2] "Enemy is hit!" But where? Which tank part did you damage? From now on, everything will be clearer! Upon a ricochet or non-penetrating hit, as well as upon damaging or destroying a module, you'll see a corresponding icon and text on the screen. The text color also indicates the extent of the damage: red means the module was knocked out of action, orange shows the module was critically damaged, and white refers to minor damage to the module, as well as non-penetrating hits. If you damaged several modules to different extents with a single shot, the results of the heaviest damage will be shown.

[i]This setting is enabled by default, but you can disable it completely or select icons without text at any time. The shot result status is available for all modes except Realistic Battles.
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/c8a973481330313069127511eb017989a69690cf.jpg[/img]

[h2]Clan Missions
[/h2] Honors have become tangible! Earned <icon> Honors will now allow you to receive credits, Free XP, unique camouflage, Premium Account, boosters, and even gold. But be aware that a lone wolf won't get these trophies as the new type of missions is only available to clan players. The contribution of each player is critically important! Join a clan, complete Personal and Clan Missions, earn Honors, and receive a reward every week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/1d36bb6ddda25174e690631efad97fb291dd8894.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Avatars for Victories[/h2] The Skirmish! and Space Corps accumulative avatars for victories in Skirmish and Gravity Force battles were introduced. These modes appear in the game from time to time. Follow the news to learn when they're available and earn a brand new avatar! 

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2] This time, changes were made to the characteristics of tank destroyers. Many Tier VI–VIII TDs received increased penetration and damage. The AT 8, Jagdpanther, T28, and other vehicles became more dangerous. In addition, the research cost of several modules was changed.

[url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/update-7-4/]Learn more![/url]

notes.title: Update 7.3
notes.notes:
[h2]Swedish Tanks
[/h2]The Tech Tree of the European Nation has grown a new, strong branch consisting of Tier VI–X tanks! The Swedes have brought national food for their provisions. Among consumables for higher-tier tanks, you will find Improved Engine Power Boost and Reticle Calibration. On top of that, two Legendary camouflages are available for the Tier X Kranvagn at once!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/dddc8097913467ca4ac56bba553fa0d16d357770.jpg[/img]

[h2]You Shall Pass! 
[/h2]We fixed crossing capacity and got rid of bugs. Low-silhouette tanks will no longer drown under the bridges in the center of the Canal map. It is now easier to destroy logs on Copperfield. From now on, vehicles won't get stuck on the crest of the waterfall on Yukon, or near the water tower on Alpenstadt. On top of that, the issue where shells didn't pass through the slit in the door of the hangar on Himmelsdorf has been fixed.

[h2]Brutality is the Color of the Season
[/h2]Such severe warpaints as Fire Sentinel, Hardy, and Oxidized Metal are back in the camo selection menu. The costs vary from 65 gold to 750 gold, depending on the vehicle tier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/47f48757d1f29fcff861a3cc4e88c28d91e90e32.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/8cc5c369c92fc2458b2fa87253cbe157b62125ad.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/84714dc3dd0e523e3a5e08639748320e0e9fb1a3.jpg[/img]

[i]The Jade Shards, Golden Carp, and Effective Concealment warpaints are no longer available for purchase.
[/i]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
• The camera sensitivity default settings have been changed from 95% to 120% in arcade mode and from 65% to 100% in sniper mode. Also, the gyroscope sensitivity has been decreased.
• The navigation panel has been added for the Consumables and Provisions screens.
• The Minus button now displays/hides the list of players.
• The bug where the Plus button didn't open the Store screen when switching from the Avatars screen has been fixed.
• Upon spending and returning in-game currency at the same time, a total final figure is now displayed instead of two ratios—"Will be returned" and "Will be deducted".
• On the Provisions and Consumables screens, if consumables are not applied, the most effective one is selected by default.
• Destroying the IS-2 Chinese heavy tank now counts towards The Lion of Sinai medal.
• The Allies HP restored ribbon has been added for some modes.
• During the pre-battle countdown, the boosters panel is now also displayed when team lists are hidden (previously, it was only displayed when the lists were shown).
• The cases of incorrect reload indication during the pre-battle countdown have been fixed.
• The bug where some logos didn't load on the tournament page has been fixed.
• The bug where the Watching Ads button didn't disappear from the battle results screen after watching an ad has been fixed.
• The bug where the vehicle panel position wasn't saved upon going to another menu and upon returning to the Garage later has been fixed.
• Various screens, descriptions, and notifications have been improved.
• General bugs and client crashes have been fixed.

[h2]Balance Improvements
[/h2]We're continuing to work on the game comfort when playing in lower-tier vehicles. In this update, the changes affected the maneuverability of several tanks, such as the M7, A20, R35, Matilda, М5 Stuart, and АМХ 38. As for higher-tier vehicles, the gun mantlet armor was changed for the Chieftain Mk.6, Super Conqueror, Object 140, T-62А, E 100, and Löwe.

[url=https://eu.wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/update-7-3/]More details in the game!
[/url]

notes.title: Update 7.0
notes.notes:
In a big way with a bang! This update features both our ideas for improvement and lots of player requests. Thank you for actively and genuinely caring about the game! The new update will delight you with its improved graphics, advanced settings, and even new tanks and effects. There are lots of cool things to see and things to try out!

[previewyoutube=RuZk46n9S6c;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Realism and beauty[/h2]Just take a look! Several remarkable graphics improvements make the atmosphere of battles more intense, including improved effects for object destruction, flames, smoke, dust, dynamic shadows, gun recoil, shell hit marks, and tank track traces. And don't worry. None of these new features affects gameplay or causes dramatic changes to the game's appearance. If your device can't pull off any of these effects, you can simply turn them off in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/ff2f8266e2a523311f2d4817d17e26beb27d122d.png[/img]

[h2]The British Tech Tree has grown[/h2]Three new Tier VIII–X light tanks are available for research! The impetuous FV301, Vickers Cruiser, and Vickers Light 105 just can't wait to get in your Garage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/e1922544c8cf272dd0bdf57d5f367d32f39b880d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Map changes[/h2]We've made some map improvements! Some bugs and spots where vehicles could get stuck were eliminated while the models of buildings and objects were adjusted. On top of that, we've removed unplanned positions on the maps Himmelsdorf, Castilla, Mayan Ruins, Naval Frontier, Winter Malinovka, Copperfield, New Bay, Dynasty's Pearl, Faust, Hellas, and Normandy.

[h2]You've got the power![/h2]There's no reason to hold back! It is now in your power to blow off the turrets of tank destroyers that were unlucky enough to have one! And you can do it in style! Just the way we like it. Making their epic departure from the battlefield are the Helsing, FV215b (183), FV4004 Conway, Charioteer, FV4005, Challenger, T30, T67, and T28 Defender.

[h2]Balance Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Bat.-Châtillon 25 t[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dispersion on the move/hull traverse was decreased from 0.12 to 0.1.
[*] Engine power was increased from 720 to 745 hp.
[/list]

[h3]STB-1[/h3]
View range was decreased from 270 to 260 m.

[h3]XM551 Sheridan[/h3]
Engine power was decreased from 650 to 485 hp.
ATGM
[list]
[*] Flight range was decreased from 450 to 300 m.
[*] Turn speed was decreased by 25%.
[/list]

[h3]T92E1[/h3]
ATGM
[list]
[*] Flight range was decreased from 450 to 300 m.
[*] Turn speed was decreased by 25%.
[/list]

[h2]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Reticle Calibration and Improved Engine Power Boost consumables were added for the following American tank destroyers: the T25 AT, T28, T95, and T110E3.
[*] The Volume setting was divided into two settings: Music Volume and Effects and System Sounds Volume.
[*] The Cooldown booster was added to the pre-battle booster panel.
[*] The username can now be changed only from the player profile (previously it was also possible from Settings).
[*] Improved shooting effects for the E 100 and the VK 90.01 (P).
[*] Improved Modules and Defense System standard equipment was replaced with Improved Modules + and Defense System + for the Firefly Saunders SP.
[*] For iOS users, the bug where the "Sign in with Apple" window appeared every time players (re)log in to the game was fixed.
[*] The bug where push notifications didn't expand for some Android devices was fixed.
[*] Cases where item icons were displayed incorrectly in Storage were fixed.
[*] Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
[/list]

[/i]

[*]Battle types were renamed battle modes and vice versa. As an example, Uprising is a battle type and Encounter is a battle mode.
[*]ATGMs: the bug that caused the absence of the sound of a flying missile when in Sniper mode was fixed.
[*]The Appearance tab: the bug that caused incorrect swiping to the installed camouflage when switching between camouflage slots was fixed.
[*]Players no longer receive notifications when their rating falls and they enter a lower league.
[*]Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.

[h1]The Tree Burst Into Bloom[/h1]
The Tech Tree has been reworked:[list][*]The design was updated.
[*] The menu with game nations was shifted to the left.
[*] Vehicle tiers are now displayed at the bottom.
[*] The national flag is now shown for researched and purchased vehicles.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/9f5100f5aee633bf935452b3faa58a6b79af6a77.jpg[/img]

[h1]Rebalancing[/h1]
[url=https://wotblitz.com/news/updates/atgm-branch/]The American XM551 Sheridan and T92E1 missileers[/url] turned out to be overpowered. We decreased their damage and penetration values to make these vehicles correspond more to their class and battle role while also making them less effective in head-on combat with heavily armored tanks. In addition, the ATGM shells became less versatile. At the same time, the vehicles' key features remained the same. Commanders can still rely on speed and maneuverability, striking opponents from the flanks, dealing a significant amount of damage per shot, and firing from behind cover using ATGMs when necessary.

The T54E1 was made faster to help it keep up with its counterparts. We also made the Somua SAu 40 stronger so it can feel more confident in battles against Tier V vehicles.

[b]XM551 Sheridan[/b][list][*]The average penetration of an APCR shell decreased from 240 to 230 mm.
[*]The average penetration of a HEAT shell decreased from 340 to 310 mm.
[*]The average damage of a HEAT shell decreased from 560 to 490 HP.
[/list]
[b]T92E1[/b][list][*]Armor thickness for the upper glacis plate decreased from 76 to 52 mm.
[*] For the 152 mm XM150E3 gun:[list][*]The average penetration of an APCR shell decreased from 240 to 230 mm.
[*] The average penetration of a HEAT shell decreased from 340 to 310 mm.
[*] The average damage of a HEAT shell decreased from 560 to 490 HP.[/list][/list]
[b]T54E1[/b][list][*]The top forward speed increased from 44 to 50 km/h.
[/list]
[b]Somua SAu 40[/b][list][*]The frontal armor was increased:[list][*]From 36 to 75 mm for the upper glacis plate and commander's cupola.
[*] From 36 to 75 mm for the vision block flaps.
[*] From 25 to 75 mm for the front shield of both guns' armor masks.[/list][/list]
[b]Consumables[/b][list][*]The Reticle Calibration duration increased from 15 to 20 seconds.
[/list]
[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h1][list][*]The cost of unresearched vehicles in credits was returned to the vehicle module research screen. Now both the research cost and the purchase cost can be seen.
[*] The booster panel displayed at the beginning of a battle now shows a counter indicating the number of remaining boosters.
[*] The battle counter in the player's profile was fixed: regular, rating, and tournament battles are now counted.
[*] The issue when the sound in the game might disappear due to an incoming call, alarm, or other notification was fixed in the iOS version of the game.
[*] The grass in Sniper mode is now displayed if this setting is enabled.
[*] The damage icon was fixed in the Vehicles tab in the player's profile.
[*] The issue of characteristics changes displaying not for the selected provisions in the Provisions screen was fixed.
[*] The loading proportion of shell type for standard ammunition when unlocking a new tank or gun was adjusted.
[*] The issue with the display of penetration zones for the Panzer 58 was fixed.
[*] The camouflage display for the FCM 36 Pak 40 and T95E2, as well as the Wings of Night attachment display for the BT-7 and M5 Stuart, was fixed.
[*] The design of some screens has been updated, while descriptions and notifications have been improved.
[*] General bugs and client crashes were fixed.[/list]

121B:[list][*]Reload time was reduced from 7.19 to 6.9 s.[/list]
FV215b:[list][*]Vehicle durability was decreased from 2,100 to 2,000 HP.[/list]
Grille 15: [list][*]Concealment upon firing while stationary was increased from 1 to 2%. This means now you'll have to move a bit closer to spot a firing Grille 15.[/list]
AMX 50 Foch (155):[list][*]The average damage of an AP shell was decreased from 640 to 560 HP for both guns.
[*]The average damage of a HE shell was decreased from 960 to 680 HP for both guns.

[*]Hull traverse speed was decreased from 52.15 to 50.06 deg/s.
[*]Dispersion on the move, as well as on hull and turret traverse, was decreased.[/list]
Prototipo Standard B:[list][*]For the Cannone da 105 Rh V1 gun:[list][*]Dispersion at 100 m was increased from 0.336 to 0.345 m.
[*]Dispersion on turret traverse was increased.[/list][/list]

[b]Tiers VI and VII[/b]

The frontal armor was enhanced for some Tier VI–VII vehicles. Thus, the number of tanks that can easily penetrate them from the front will reduce. Now, you'll have to aim at vulnerable areas or attack the flanks more often when firing at these vehicles.

Enhanced main armor:[list][*]Black Prince: from 152 to 180 mm for the hull's front.
[*]IS-2: from 90 to 120 mm for the hull's front and from 100 to 140 mm for the top turret.
[*]IS: from 120 to 155 mm for the hull's front and from 100 to 140 mm for the top turret.
[*]IS-2 (1945): from 100 to 140 mm for the turret's front.

[*]T25 AT: from 120 to 145 mm for the hull's front.
[*]Jagdpanther: from 80 to 120 mm for the hull's front.
[*]Panther I: from 85 to 110 mm for the hull's front and from 120 to 160 mm for the top turret.
[*]Tiger I: from 100 to 165 mm for the hull's front.[/list]
Also, different parts of the frontal armor (cabins, hatches, cupolas, guns and their mantlets, etc.) were reinforced for the AT 8, AT 7, and aforementioned vehicles.


[h1]Improvements and Fixed Bugs[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/fc833b44e52dd8c81d78fd04191ded632b204ef7.jpg[/img][list][*]The "Receive messages only from friends" setting was added. It is enabled by default.
[*]An eleventh mission was added for the iOS and Android versions of the game: watch 5 video ads. Reward: 500–1,500 Free EXP depending on the mission level.
[*]When selecting a turret, the change to elevation/depression angles is now displayed in the vehicle characteristics.

[*]The red indicator for new messages in chat is no longer displayed if all messages have been read.

[*]Upon purchasing a tank, consumables are now automatically mounted on it.
[*]The bug where Adrenaline didn't disappear on the consumables screen upon changing a standard gun to a magazine-based was fixed.
[*]The bug in the range finder armor on the E 75's turret was fixed.
[*]Various screens, descriptions, and notifications were improved.
[*]General bugs and client crashes were fixed.[/list]

notes.title: Update 6.5
notes.notes:
This is it! The update that will save Horrorstadt from the midnight spells and change everything (well... almost everything) back. In this update, we reworked the interface, added new camouflages and avatars, and improved the characteristics of Premium vehicles. Also, someone played with the brightness, contrast, and saturation sliders, and a certain day of the week became much darker.

[h1]Watch the update video review and download the new version from November 20![/h1]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w9wxvI5wlRY
[h1]New Garage Interface[/h1]
The design of numerous screens was updated, animations were added, and access to important functions became easier. The key changes include:
[list][*]The main menu is now always open and is displayed as icons on the left side of the screen. It became easier to enter the needed section and notice any updates thanks to red indicators. In the left side menu, you can find: profile, news and notifications, Tech Tree, missions, storage, clans, platoon game, tournaments, communities, and settings.[/*][*]The player's current rating and the corresponding league are now displayed under the avatar in the upper left corner.[/*][*]In the vehicle panel, vehicles are now sorted from the highest tier to the lowest, and the button with filters is on the right.[/*][*]The menu with tank filters was improved. The filters of Elite and Non-Elite vehicles are now separated from the vehicle type (researchable, Premium, Collector). A counter of filtered vehicles was introduced.[/*][*]The Upgrades and Crew tabs were added to the vehicle enhancement screen. Now, info about the level of enhancements of the selected vehicle, as well as all possible actions with this vehicle, are available in one place.[/*][*]Clan search, nickname change, replays, and the list of received rewards can now be found in the Profile screen.[/*][*]Notifications in the upper part of the screen became more compact and no longer fully cover this part of the screen.[/*][/list]
In fact, the improvements are much more numerous. But, as it's said, it's better to see them once than to hear about them a thousand times. The screens and interface elements that remained untouched will be changed in future updates.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1][list][*]WZ-113, WZ-121, and M4A1 Revalorisé: increased damage.[/*][*]WZ-120: reduced reload and aiming time.[/*][*]Chieftain/T95: enhanced armor and increased penetration.[/*][*]T95E2 and Churchill Mk. VI: enhanced armor.[/*][*]The profitability of researchable Tier III tanks was changed.[/*][*]The cost in credits of researchable Tier IV vehicles was increased.[/*][*]The cost to unlock equipment for Tier I–V vehicles was significantly reduced.[/*][/list]
[url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/vehicle-changes-6-5/]Read more[/url]

[h1]Appearance and Avatars[/h1][list][*]A Legendary camouflage called Roaring was added for the E 50 Ausf. M. Cost: 2,550 gold.
[/*][*]Rare camouflages called Elemental Breath and On the Edge, winners of the [url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/event/smashing-camo-contest-results/]camo contest[/url], were added. Cost: 42,000–600,000 credits depending on the vehicle tier. Can be resupplied for free.[/*][*]A Rare camouflage called Ancient Relic was added. Also, the Iron Will warpaint became available for purchase again. Cost: 65–750 gold depending on the vehicle tier. Can be resupplied for free.[/*][*]The following warpaints were removed from sale: Spooky Web, Pumpkin Mayhem, Hardy, Missile Salvo, Missile Arsenal, Thunder and Lightning.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 6.3
notes.notes:
It finally happened! The European nation, the highly anticipated new branch, becomes available September 18! Research it to the top and enjoy the advantages of an Italian Tier X tank with an autoreloading system. Dress the Progetto M40 mod. 65 and P.44 Pantera in a Legendary camouflage right off the bat. Last but not least, try out the provisions and consumables introduced in recent updates on Chinese tank destroyers and American heavies. 
[previewyoutube=L27Rpjxrx7g;full][/previewyoutube]
[h1]New Nation[/h1]
[url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/eu-nation/]The European nation[/url] has joined the game. For Tiers VIII–X, it is represented by Italian medium tanks featuring [url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/autoreloading-system/]a gun autoreloading system[/url]. The branch includes: Vickers Mk. F, 10TP, 14TP, Lago, Strv m/42, P.43 bis, P.43 ter, P.44 Pantera, Prototipo Standard B, Progetto M40 mod. 65.
Each tank has its national flag as the background. At the same time, a union flag of the European nation is used to represent the whole branch for the pre-tutorial screen, Tech Tree screen, Profile statistics screen, and vehicle selection filter.
[b]With the release of Update 6.3, all players will receive the Vickers Mk. F and a Garage slot. [/b]

[h1]Provisions and Consumables[/h1]
The Cinnamon Roll (+3% to crew mastery) and Cheesehead (+10% to crew mastery) provisions are available for Tier VI–X tanks of the European nation. Tier IV and V vehicles can only grab a cinnamon roll for the battle. 
The Reticle Calibration and Reactive Armor consumables, as well as the Sandbag Armor and Enhanced Sandbag Armor provisions, are now available for Chinese Tier VII–X tank destroyers.
The Improved Engine Power Boost and Reactive Armor consumables, as well as the Sandbag Armor and Enhanced Sandbag Armor provisions, are now available for American Tier VII–X heavies in the T110E5 branch.

[h1]Camouflage[/h1]
You can dress the Italian newcomers in a Legendary camouflage right off the bat:
[list]
[*] Furious for the P.44 Pantera at 1,450 gold. Changes the tank name in battle to P.44 Pantera Furious.
[*] Gladiator for the Progetto M40 mod. 65 at 2,550 gold. Changes the tank name in battle to Progetto 65 Gladiator.
[/list]
Or get a Common camouflage using 50–3,000 credits (for all vehicles of the European nation):
[list]
[*] Heatwave and Tree Bark for summer maps.
[*] Winter Steppe and Ice Mosaic for winter maps.
[*] Sun-scorched and Bronze Green for desert maps.
[/list]
The following new Rare camouflages can be applied to all vehicles in the game:
[list]
[*] Area 52 for 65–750 gold.
[*] Golden Carp for 65–750 gold.
[/list]
The Missile Arsenal and Missile Salvo Rare camouflages are back in the Store for 65–750 gold.
While the Full Forward, Retro, Blitz, and Faster, Higher, Stronger camouflages are no longer available for purchase.
Take a closer look at the new camouflages in [url=https://wotblitz.com/en/news/updates/camouflage-6-3/]the Camouflage in Update 6.3[/url] article.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
Engine power was increased from 650 to 750 hp for the WZ-113G FT.
Gun reload time was reduced from 9.11 to 8.34 s for the WZ-121.
[b]Tiger II[/b]
Increased armor:
[list]
[*] From 150 to 160 mm for the upper glacis plate.
[*] From 120 to 160 mm for the lower glacis plate.
[*] From 80 to 100 mm for the upper part of the side.
[/list]
Increased top turret armor:
[list]
[*] From 185 to 220 mm for the front.
[*] From 80 to 100 mm for the side.
[*] From 40 to 55 mm for the turret roof.
[*] From 80 to 100 mm for the commander's cupola.
[*] From 80 to 180 mm for the gun mount.
[*] From 0 to 180 mm for the gun mount opening.
[*] To 180 mm for all gun mantlets (previous values varied from 20 to 145 mm).
[/list]
[b]VK 36.01 (H)[/b]
Increased armor:
[list]
[*] From 100 to 145 mm for the upper glacis plate.
[*] From 100 to 145 mm for the machine gun's mantlet and covers of the drive wheels.
[*] From 86 to 100 mm for the lower glacis plate and upper part of the transmission roof.
[*] From 60 to 80 mm for the lower part of the side.
[*] From 60 to 80 mm for the side hatches and bottom of the rear.
[*] From 0 to 80 mm for the side rear observation slits.
[*] From 100 to 145 mm for the driver's observation slit.
[/list]
Increased top turret armor:
[list]
[*] From 100 to 145 mm for the front.
[*] From 60 to 100 mm for the rear part of the mantlet.
[*] From 0 to 100 mm for the gun mount opening.
[*] To 135 mm for all gun mantlets (previous values varied from 20 to 100 mm).
[/list]

[h1]New Matchmaker Rule[/h1]
Testing of the matchmaker rule for players who show extremely low efficiency in recent series of battles has been extended for CIS and EU live servers.

[h1]Medals[/h1]
You can put some more medals on your chest:
[list]
[*] Technical Engineer: European Nation — research all tanks of the European nation.
[*] Expert: European Nation — destroy each tank of the European nation at least once.
[/list]

[h1]National Flag[/h1]
The Ram II is now displayed with the Canadian flag as a background, while the AC 1 Sentinel and AC IV Sentinel are with the Australian flag. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494313/58375a80f38465eb3f1d9ef4e4665b593c28d21a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
A hole between the T-44's triplex and turret was removed.
On Vineyards, bushes and windmill will no longer be able to stop shells with invisible textures. Also, gaps between objects and terrain were removed.
For the Mines and New Bay maps, unplanned passages and areas where players could get stuck were removed. 
The Black Dragon camouflage, when used on the Dead Rail map, will no longer look like a hole in space.
Various screens, notifications, and descriptions were improved. 
General bugs and client crashes were fixed.
